subject: random (group specific) over-dispersion values in a hierarchical regression

messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: random (group specific) over-dispersion values in a hierarchical regression
parts:
Hello,

I have the following random slope random intercept regression model:

itest = inla(y~ x +
                     f(group1, x, model = "iid") + 
                     f(group2, model = "iid"), 
                     Ntrials = trials,
                     family = c("betabinomial"),
                     data = data.frame(y,x,trials))

Is there a way to specific a model to let the over dispersion parameter vary by group?
i.e. something like 
oversispersion ~ 1 + f(group3, model = "iid")

Best, Guido

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] random (group specific) over-dispersion values in a hierarchical regression
parts:
Hi,

currently not. if the number of groups are small, you can have one
likelihood model for each group, hence one overdispersion pr group
